rows.grounds: dative of purpose for obtaining a son
dative of purpose for protection of all
optative third singular active of root pūj
locative plural referring to previously named recipients

items.question: For what purposes should one worship them in that order?
items.inference: Ordered worship secures progeny and universal protection.
uncertainties: The antecedent of teṣu is not explicit in this excerpt.
items.plain_english: One should worship them in that order for obtaining a son and for all protection.
